device_entry.name: Prior 电动 XY 载物台
tags: 样品/探针定位与运动控制
显微成像与光学显微实验
device_entry.description: 用于显微镜或实验平台样品定位的电动二维平移载物台，可读取当前位置，并执行 X/Y 方向微米级相对移动与指定坐标绝对移动，同时检查软限位和硬限位以避免超程。
device_entry.description_en: A motorized 2D translation stage for sample positioning on microscopes or laboratory platforms. It can report the current position, perform micron-scale relative motion in X and Y, move to specified coordinates, and check soft and hard travel limits to avoid overtravel.
